check_IsKeyword: check if a given token string is a C++ keyword using the IsKeyword function
check_IsBuiltinType: check if a given token string is a C++ builtin type using the IsBuiltinType function
list_ALL_keywords: list all C++ keywords by importing the ALL set from the keywords module
list_TYPES: list all C++ type keywords by importing the TYPES set from the keywords module
list_CONTROL: list all C++ control flow keywords by importing the CONTROL set from the keywords module
